correctness.rationale: The piecewise reflection-shear map has determinant +1 on every affine branch, is positively homogeneous, and preserves its positive-definite piecewise quadratic invariant for 0<pq<4. Area of unit level disk is three integrals of 1/(1+k z+z^2) and one of 1/(1-k z+z^2), giving (pi+2theta)/(2 k sin theta). Homogeneity plus area preservation maps radial sectors to equal-area sectors; image of positive s-axis has clockwise transformed angle 2theta, so each level map is conjugate to rotation rho=2theta/(pi+2theta). Rational theta/pi=a/b has precise least period (b+2a)/gcd(2,b); irrational theta has dense uniquely ergodic level orbits. Independent numeric orbit check at theta=2pi/7 returns period 11.
